title: Development study: calibrated action-conditioned safety-risk adviser

suite.family_source: Issue #55 v2 development family matrix, reused without scenario expansion
suite.family_matrix: 4 operating conditions x 4 physical plant conditions x 2 sensor seeds
suite.candidate_schedule: each frozen catalogue command is repeated unchanged for the 32-step label horizon

features.history_summary: last projected numeric row, window mean, and last-minus-first delta
features.action: one complete frozen catalogue command vector
features.layout: float32[610] = 194 last + 194 mean + 194 delta + 27 action + 1 bias
prohibited_inputs: fault labels or future fault schedule

labels.event: any target crosses a frozen safety bound during the next 32 transitions
labels.exposure: sum of normalized lower and upper bound crossings over all target cells and 32 transitions
labels.maximum_crossing: maximum normalized bound crossing over all target cells and 32 transitions
labels.eligibility: incomplete or infeasible counterfactuals are excluded, never assigned a finite penalty

model.kind: train-only normalized ridge multi-output risk regressor
model.float_policy: fit float64, frozen inference output float32

calibration.abstain_if: all candidates are hard-ineligible or no finite calibrated prediction exists

ranking.hard_ineligible: upper_exposure > 0.5 OR crossing_probability >= 0.5 OR non-finite output
ranking.tie_break: score, upper_exposure, crossing_probability, intervention, hold_preference, action_id
ranking.proposal: at most one standard advisory proposal bound to the verified current snapshot
ranking.existing_point_model: measured as a comparator, not modified by this lane

metrics.primary: true-plant safety exposure and safety violation steps
metrics.family_aggregation: equal-weight family means; paired family identities retained
metrics.bootstrap: 10,000 deterministic whole-family resamples using SHA256 counter sampling seed 560056

success_criteria.safety_gate: EVALUATION true-plant safety exposure point and upper paired interval must be <= rules_only
success_criteria.crossing_gate: crossing-event recall difference must be >= -0.02 and false-event rate difference <= +0.01
success_criteria.honest_negative_rule: utility improvement never overrides a failed safety gate; failed comparative gates are published

non_goals: no HMC, safety-core, physics, trace, capability, or replay changes
no final-suite or validation data access outside this declared development corpus
no deployment, qualification, certification, hardware, or real-world safety claim

reproducibility.determinism_rule: no wall-clock values or unseeded randomness in digest-bearing outputs
reproducibility.artifact_rule: model, corpus, calibration, results, and source identities are SHA-256 bound
